defect_observations: C001 restricts the definition to integrable families; Durrett's definition implies integrability (sup E|X_i| <= M + 1), so no family is lost.
C017 states the absorption hypothesis for positive integers K instead of Durrett's real x (delta(x) > 0 on {X_n <= x}); the two forms are equivalent through the integer ceiling, so no case is lost.
